next.reason: 1985: 'The END-CALL phrase delimits the scope of the CALL statement.' §2023:14.9.4.2 keeps '[ END-CALL ]' in both CALL formats; §2023:14.5.1 Table 12 lists END-CALL as the CALL statement's explicit scope terminator (no catalog id), and §2023:14.5.3.2 GR1 and GR2 say it terminates 'the most-recently preceding unterminated statement having the statement-name for which that scope terminator is defined' and any unterminated statements between, as the 1985 scope rules did. Same meaning.
